# Placeholder icons

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask icons` from sources.txt; do not edit. -->

Interim art behind REDA's semantic icon keys (docs/spec/v0.1/app.md#icons), until REDA's own MIT set replaces every one of them before the first public release. Each SVG is copied from the npm package below, with comments and `class` attributes removed and `currentColor` rewritten to `#fff`, the dark-theme colour reda-ui swaps for the light theme on load. To change one, edit `sources.txt` and run `cargo xtask icons`.

| Set | Package | Licence |
|---|---|---|
| Lucide | `lucide-static@1.66.0` | ISC (parts MIT, from Feather), in `LICENSE-lucide.txt` |
| Tabler | `@tabler/icons@3.50.0` | MIT, in `LICENSE-tabler.txt` |

Every icon below was drawn by its set's authors and vendored unmodified apart from the rewrite above.
